These were followed by Lancie, the dearest of her flock to Mrs. Grainger, for a mother, though full of tenderness for all her children, always loves the afflicted most. arxiv-1709-05111.title: Activity Archetypes in Question-and-Answer (Q&A) Websites - A Study of 50 Stack Exchange Instances DOI: 0000001.0000001 CCS: Mathematics of computing Cluster analysis CCS: Mathematics of computing Time series analysis CCS: Information systems Answer ranking CCS: Human-centered computing Web-based in
arxiv-1709-05111.creator: Tiago Santos, Simon Walk, Roman Kern, Markus Strohmaier, Denis Helic
arxiv-1709-05111.description: Abstract . Millions of users on the Internet discuss a variety of topics on Question-and-Answer (Q&A) instances. However, not all instances and topics receive the same amount of attention, as some thrive and achieve self-sustaining levels of activity, while others fail to attract users and either never grow beyond being a small niche community or become inactive.

arxiv-2110-13463.title: Multi-scale Deterministic Optimisation of Blended Composite Structures: Case Study of a Box-Wing
arxiv-2110-13463.creator: Marco Picchi Scardaoni, Michele Iacopo Izzi, Marco Montemurro, Enrico Panettieri, Vittorio Cipolla, Vincenzo Binante
arxiv-2110-13463.description: Abstract This work presents a multi-scale design methodology for the deterministic optimisation of thin-walled composite structures integrating a global-local approach for the assessment of the buckling strength and a dedicated strategy to recover blended stacking sequences. The methodology is based on the multi-scale two-level optimisation strategy for anisotropic materials and structures.

arxiv-2211-14363.title: Homology-constrained vector quantization entropy regularizer
arxiv-2211-14363.creator: Ivan Volkov
arxiv-2211-14363.description: Abstract Homology-constrained vector quantization entropy regularizer Abstract This paper describes an entropy regularization term for vector quantization (VQ) based on the analysis of persistent homology of the VQ embeddings. Higher embedding entropy positively correlates with higher codebook utilization, mitigating overfit towards the identity and codebook collapse in VQ-based autoencoders [ 1 ] .

arxiv-2212-12924.title: Quantum Induced Coherence Light Detection and Ranging
arxiv-2212-12924.creator: Gewei Qian 1 , Xingqi Xu 1,∗ , Shun-An Zhu 1 , Chenran Xu 1 , Fei Gao 2 , V. V. Yakovlev 3 , Xu Liu 1 , Shi-Yao Zhu 1,4 and Da-Wei Wang 1,4,5,†
arxiv-2212-12924.description: Abstract Quantum illumination has been proposed and demonstrated to improve the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) in light detection and ranging (LiDAR). When relying on coincidence detection, such a quantum LiDAR is limited by the response time of the detector and suffers from jamming noise.

arxiv-2310-00599.title: Approximate filtering via discrete dual processes Corresponding author: ESOMAS Dept., Corso Unione Sovietica 218/bis, 10134, Torino, Italy; matteo.ruggiero@unito.it
arxiv-2310-00599.creator: Guillaume Kon Kam King, Université Paris-Saclay - INRAE
arxiv-2310-00599.description: Abstract We consider the task of filtering a dynamic parameter evolving as a diffusion process, given data collected at discrete times from a likelihood which is conjugate to the reversible law of the diffusion, when a generic dual process on a discrete state space is available.

arxiv-2403-08163.title: Effective Underwater Glider Path Planning in Dynamic 3D Environments Using Multi-Point Potential Fields
arxiv-2403-08163.creator: Hanzhi Yang, Nina Mahmoudian
arxiv-2403-08163.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Hanzhi Yang, Nina Mahmoudian. Underwater gliders (UGs) have emerged as highly effective unmanned vehicles for ocean exploration. However, their operation in dynamic and complex underwater environments necessitates robust path-planning strategies. Previous studies have primarily focused on global energy or time-efficient path planning in explored environments, overlooking challenges posed by unpredictable flow conditions and unknown obstacles in varying and dynamic areas like fjords and near-harbor waters.

arxiv-2406-05262.title: A Three-groups Non-local Model for Combining Heterogeneous Data Sources to Identify Genes Associated with Parkinson’s Disease
arxiv-2406-05262.creator: Troy P. Wixson 1,∗, Benjamin A. Shaby 1, Daisy L. Philtron 2, International Parkinson Disease Genomics Consortium (IPDGC) 3 , Leandro A. Lima 4 , Stacia K. Wyman 5 , Julia A. Kaye 4 , and Steven Finkbeiner 4,6,7 1 Department of Statistics, Colorado State University, Fort Collins, Colorado, U.S.A. 2
arxiv-2406-05262.description: Abstract We seek to identify genes involved in Parkinson’s Disease (PD) by combining information across different experiment types. Each experiment, taken individually, may contain too little information to distinguish some important genes from incidental ones. However, when experiments are combined using the proposed statistical framework, additional power emerges.

arxiv-2412-03164.title: Lebesgue constants for the Walsh system and the discrepancy of the van der Corput sequence
arxiv-2412-03164.creator: Josef Dick, Friedrich Pillichshammer
arxiv-2412-03164.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Josef Dick, Friedrich Pillichshammer. In this short note we report on a coincidence of two mathematical quantities that, at first glance, have little to do with each other. On the one hand, there are the Lebesgue constants of the Walsh function system that play an important role in approximation theory, and on the other hand there is the star discrepancy of the van der Corput sequence that plays a prominent role in uniform distribution theory.

arxiv-2504-02686.title: Degrees and prime power order zeros of characters of symmetric and alternating groups Thanks: This is the accepted manuscript for an article published in the Bulletin of the London Mathematical Society, available online at https://doi.org/10.1112/blms.70160 .
arxiv-2504-02686.creator: Eugenio Giannelli, Stacey Law, Eoghan McDowell
arxiv-2504-02686.description: Abstract . We show that the p p -part of the degree of an irreducible character of a symmetric group is completely determined by the set of vanishing elements of p p -power order. As a corollary we deduce that the set of zeros of prime power order controls the degree of such a character.

arxiv-2504-09719.title: Notes on Riordan arrays and lattice paths
arxiv-2504-09719.description: Abstract In this note, we explore links between Riordan arrays and lattice paths. We begin by describing Riordan arrays, and some of their generalizations, including rectifications and triangulations. We the consider Riordan array links to lattice paths with steps of type ( a , b ) (a,b) , where a a and b b are nonnegative.

arxiv-2508-10487.creator: L. Ducci, E. Perinati, P. Romano, S. Vercellone, M. Nikołajuk, A. Santangelo, M. Sasaki

pmc-11738620.title: Emotional Intelligence (EI) Workshops for Core Trainee Psychiatry Doctors
pmc-11738620.creator: Kuljit Mandair, Amitav Narula
pmc-11738620.description: AimsEmotional Intelligence (EI) is a skill that can help doctors be more effective leaders, work well with others and display the ability of self-control in stressful situations so one is able to act in a calm and rational manner. It is defined as the awareness of one's own emotions and emotions in others and how this affects behaviour.

pmc-12365089.title: Microwave modes of ambidextrous helices
pmc-12365089.creator: J Gudge-Brooke, N Clow, A P Hibbins, A W Powell, J R Sambles
pmc-12365089.description: This work presents an investigation into the electromagnetic properties of ambidextrous helices, structures composed of equal numbers of left- and right-handed turns, operating in the gigahertz frequency range. Unlike conventional single-handed helices, which support only hybridized, elliptically polarized modes, ambidextrous helices exhibit two distinct linearly polarised resonant modes: one with electric dipole-like behaviour and the other with magnetic dipole-like behaviour.

pmc-12612138.title: Efficacy and safety of emulsified microsomal ferric pyrophosphate vs. Ferrous Ascorbate in pregnancy with iron-deficiency anemia- a randomized, comparative study
pmc-12612138.creator: Ameet Patki, G. S. Jyothi, Vidya Thobbi, Ankita Srivastav, Gayatri Ganu, Alok S. Shah
pmc-12612138.description: This study evaluates the efficacy and safety of emulsified microsomal Ferric pyrophosphate (EMFP/SunActive™ Fe, 27 mg elemental iron) versus Ferrous Ascorbate (100 mg elemental iron) in second-trimester pregnant women with iron-deficiency anemia (IDA) for 4 weeks. Pregnant women aged 20–35 years with a singleton pregnancy, hemoglobin (Hb) 9–10.5 g/dL, and ferritin < 15 mcg/L were enrolled.

pmc-12930467.title: Sex testing in women's sport: historical harms, contemporary risks, and World Athletics' 2025 policy shift
pmc-12930467.creator: Silvia Camporesi, Marcus Mazzucco, Maria José Martínez Patiño, Jonathan Ospina-Betancurt, Sarah Teetzel
pmc-12930467.description: The history of systemic, mandatory sex testing of all women athletes in sport is now well documented, with hundreds of articles, entire books, and doctoral dissertations analyzing the scientific, legal, and ethical aspects of sports governing bodies' determination to verify that competitors in the women's event were women and that men did not sneak into women's sports.

pmc-12995509.title: Maternal High‐Fat Diet and Neonatal LPS Exposure Prolong USV Sequences and Shift Call‐Type Repertoires in Neonatal Rats
pmc-12995509.creator: Mansi Kamlesh Purohit, Ingrid Woo, Mouly Rahman, Sameera Abuaish, Patrick O. McGowan
pmc-12995509.description: Rodent pups emit ultrasonic vocalizations (USVs) to solicit maternal care, enhancing survival. Inflammatory stressors, such as maternal high‐fat diet (mHFD) and neonatal lipopolysaccharide (nLPS) exposure, affect neonatal neurodevelopment and behavior. Although basic features of USVs are widely used to assess these impacts, their sonographic and syntax characteristics remain underexplored.

pmc-13597748.title: Association between ambient PM2.5 exposure during pregnancy and risk of preterm birth: a retrospective birth cohort study in Chengdu, Southwest China
pmc-13597748.creator: Yi Zhang, Keyao Lv, Yuping Yuan, Ruifeng Li, Xinbin Li
pmc-13597748.description: BackgroundPrenatal PM2.5 exposure has been associated with preterm birth (PTB), but evidence on exposure windows and population heterogeneity remain inconsistent.MethodsThis retrospective cohort included 35,136 singleton births at a Chengdu hospital from 2015 to 2024. Satellite- and monitor-based PM2.5 exposures were estimated for conventional and fixed gestational windows.

uslaw-usc-t18-s5.title: 18 U.S.C. § 5 — United States defined
uslaw-usc-t18-s5.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s5.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part I (Crimes); Chapter 1 (General Provisions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The term “United States”, as used in this title in a territorial sense, includes all places and waters, continental or insular, subject to the jurisdiction of the United States, except the Canal Zone.
